verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is an AI-driven game engine and platform with an MCP server, a CLI and hosted services, so recurring scheduled jobs are a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence describes scheduling, cron-style triggers or recurring workflows. The docs cover one-off agent actions such as publishing via MCP/CLI and a `--dry-run` preview, which are neither a recurring schedule nor sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
